description.value:
护甲（重甲），极珍稀（需同调）

这套护甲与外表与关节处均装有齿轮，这些齿轮彼此咬合。它自 机械境Mechanus 的秩序魔法中汲取能量。

这套护甲具有4发充能。穿戴盔甲期间，每当你进行一次[[/r d20]]掷骰时，你都可以消耗1发充能将你已骰出的骰值改为10。这套护甲在每日黎明时分恢复[[/r 1d4]]发已消耗的充能数。

The outside surface and internal joints of this armor whir with interlocking gears, drawing on the orderly magic of the plane of Mechanus.

The armor has 4 charges. If you make a [[/r d20]] roll while wearing this armor, you can expend 1 charge to change the number rolled to a 10. The armor regains [[/r 1d4]] expended charges daily at dawn.

Base items. This item variant can be applied to the following base items:

  • @item[Chain Mail|PHB] (@item[Clockwork Chain Mail|BMT])
  • @item[Plate Armor|PHB] (@item[Clockwork Plate Armor|BMT])
  • @item[Ring Mail|PHB] (@item[Clockwork Ring Mail|BMT])
  • @item[Splint Armor|PHB] (@item[Clockwork Splint Armor|BMT])
